bullets: • Name exact CSS selector and property; specify old and new numeric values with units.
• Confirm all other properties in that selector remain unchanged post-commit.
• Require CSS modification in style block diff; reject version or changelog-only changes.
• State conditions verifiable by inspecting file diffs alone, no tool execution needed.
• Ground AC in observable property values; omit why the change was made.
• Use before-and-after notation for numeric comparisons; include units consistently.
• Write AC as testable assertions, not implementation steps or rationale.
• Exclude non-stylesheet files, external dependencies, and accessibility requirements from scope.
